icon.description: As the icon of a harness profile (Harness Profile Schema).

executable.description: Name of the serving program; the operator enrols its absolute path, and the runtime checks that it owns the listening socket of base_url.

update_evidence.description: As headless.update_evidence of a harness profile (Update Evidence).

protocol.description: The request and answer format; a new protocol is a change of this list and of the code, made once for all endpoints.

readiness_path.description: A path answering 200 once the program serves; null: the models path is the readiness check.

models_pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the array of model objects in the answer of models_path; each object's id is a model id.

result_schema.description: Measured: enforced, the endpoint holds its answer to a JSON Schema sent with the request; advisory, it accepts the schema and does not hold to it; none, it refuses it. The server validates every answer itself in each case.

context_tokens.description: Measured: the largest request, prompt and answer together, the endpoint accepts.

answer_reserve_tokens.description: The part of context_tokens kept for the answer.

model_tiers.description: As headless.model_tiers of a harness profile (Model Tiers & Models of a Harness).

weights_probe.description: How the identity of a model's weights is read (Weights Identity); null: the harness reports none.

pointer.description: For models_listing: the JSON Pointer, relative to a model object of the listing, to its weights identity.

argv.description: For argv: a probe run without a shell, with the slot {{model}}.

pattern.description: For argv: the pattern whose first group in the probe's output is the weights identity.
